dynamic-element.dynamic-content: Important Update: System Verified MSE is Live only for Services Bids (Date -10/09/2025)
सेवा बोलियों में एमएसई स्थिति का प्रणाली द्वारा सत्यापन

dynamic-element.name: Text50680698
dynamic-element.dynamic-content: This is to inform you that the Buyer Verified MSE tag has been removed from the Technical Evaluation page. Going forward, Buyer verification of MSE will no longer be applicable in the system. Now, MSE verification will be carried out based on the Bidder’s active MSE profile, and users with valid MSE registration will have the option to upload supporting MSE documents in the services bids.
10 सितंबर 2025 से प्रकाशित सेवा बोलियों के लिए जेम बोलीदाता की सक्रिय प्रोफ़ाइल से एमएसई स्थिति सत्यापित करता है।

dynamic-element.name: RichText13464850
dynamic-element.dynamic-content:
#.Buyer Verified MSE will not be available for Service Bids from now onwards.

#.MSE details will be checked and verified directly from the Bidder/Seller’s profile.

#.Only Bidders with an active MSE in their profile will get the option to upload MSE documents during participation.

#. If MSE is not active in the profile, the Bidder/Seller will receive an advisory to update their profile during bid participation.

#.Buyer will get option to view the document that has been uploaded by the Bidder. Buyer will not have option to make any action on the MSE part. Rest Seek Clarification and qualification /disqualification will be applicable as per the Bid Flow.

Note: This implementation is applicable only for the Services Bids Published from today (10-09-2025) All existing/ongoing bids will continue as per the old process

#.Only Bidders with an active MSE in their profile will get the option to upload MSE documents during participation.

#. If MSE is not active in the profile, the Bidder/Seller will receive an advisory to update their profile during bid participation.

#.Buyer will get option to view the document that has been uploaded by the Bidder. Buyer will not have option to make any action on the MSE part. Rest Seek Clarification and qualification /disqualification will be applicable as per the Bid Flow.
